items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Because Paul Lomengus, he was a good reader too. I know how much why. He was first class.

ctx.x: No, they had entertainers. Entertainers that sang all around the same place.

Yeah, we had four people. The fellow would take and raise the music and the corner play, he played on special chorus. Played the saxophone part. We'd write a lot for him, you see, with our four pieces. Because Louie would do it too. They would get a piano part and write the whole four pieces out. Yeah. Because Paul Lomengus, he was a good reader too. I know how much why. He was first class. But many of these fellows, they couldn't read too much. Yeah. But if they hear something, they can play it good the fellow…
A wonderful ear of some of those people.
